title: Limodded 2
description: Limodded 2 is a massive Fabric 1.21.1 modpack combining stunning world generation, deep automation, a rich food system, skills & progression, and countless quality-of-life improvements — built for both the official Limodded 2 server and singleplayer.
body:
# Limodded 2

The official modpack for the **Limodded 2** server — and for everyone who wants a rich, 
handcrafted Minecraft experience on **Fabric 1.21.1**.

Limodded 2 combines dozens of carefully chosen mods into one cohesive pack. Whether you're 
exploring jaw-dropping landscapes, automating your base, cooking up a feast, fighting 
eldritch bosses, or just vibing with proximity voice chat — there's always something to do.


### **DEVELOPMENT PAUSED**
Development is currently paused as I do not have a testing environment available.

---

## 🌍 World Generation & Exploration
A completely overhauled world awaits. Terralith × Tectonic reshape the overworld with dramatic 
terrain, while Biomes O' Plenty, Oh The Biomes We've Gone, Nature's Spirit, and Regions 
Unexplored fill it with hundreds of unique biomes. YUNG's suite reworks every vanilla structure 
from scratch — caves, dungeons, strongholds, ocean monuments, and more. Better Nether & Better 
End transform the other dimensions entirely, and Eternal Starlight adds a whole new one.

## ⚙️ Automation & Storage
Build powerful systems with **Refined Storage**, **Tom's Simple Storage**, and **CC: Tweaked** 
for full Lua-programmable automation. Cable Tiers and wireless transmitters let you scale up 
your networks across your entire base — or across dimensions.

## 🍖 Food & Farming
A huge food ecosystem powered by **Farmer's Delight** and a fleet of addons — ~~Nature's Delight,~~ More Delight, AutoChef's Delight, and biome-specific cutting board integrations. Cooking for Blockheads adds a proper kitchen, and Fabric Seasons makes harvests feel meaningful.

## ⚔️ Combat & Progression
Eldritch Mobs and Illager Invasion shake up combat with dangerous new enemies. A full 
**skills & attributes system** (Puffish Skills + Attributes) lets you build your character 
over time. Enchanting is expanded with Easy Magic, Enchanting Infuser, Universal Enchants, 
and more. And yes — there's a **Void Totem** for those close calls.

## 🏠 Building & Decoration
Macaw's full suite (bridges, doors, windows, roofs, lights, furniture, fences, stairs, 
paintings, trapdoors) plus Supplementaries, Amendments, Stoneworks, and Chisels & Bits give 
you everything you need to build something truly unique. Diagonal blocks (walls, fences, 
windows) make builds look even more polished.

## 🛠️ Quality of Life
- **Traveler's Backpack** + **Iron Chests/Barrels/Ladders** for storage on the go
- **Xaero's Minimap & Worldmap** + **Waystones** for navigation
- **Jade** (+ Addons) for block and entity info at a glance
- **JEI** (+ Addons) for all your recipe needs
- **Veinminer** & **Falling Trees** for efficient resource gathering
- **Inventory Profiles Next** for automatic inventory sorting
- **Carry On** to pick up and move blocks and mobs
- **Gravestones** so you never lose your items on death
- **Simple Voice Chat** for proximity voice communication

## 🚀 Performance
Sodium, Lithium, ModernFix, ImmediatelyFast, FerriteCore, Entity Culling, Dynamic FPS, More 
Culling, and more ensure the pack runs smoothly — even with all these mods loaded.
